summary: Archivio multi-select for ISSUED declarations + batch PDF export + pdf.ts refactor regression + Cedolino columns fully verified end-to-end at mobile viewport 390x844 (frontend-only). Login tecnico@lab.it/password123 → Archivio shows 4 items (1 DRAFT DC-2026-0004 + 3 ISSUED DC-2026-000{1..3}). enter-select renders 4 select-checkbox-<id> circles (draft's is dimmed via checkCircleDisabled). Tapping the DRAFT card correctly triggers the info toast 'Solo le dichiarazioni emesse sono selezionabili' and does NOT change selectedIds — 0 selezionate remains. Tapping an ISSUED card toggles selection: 1 selezionate → tap again → 0 selezionate; the cardChecked border appears. select-all ('Tutte'): from 0 selected it picks ALL currently-filtered ISSUED (3 with 'Tutte' or 'Emesse' filter; 0 under 'Bozze'; 1 when search=Corona narrows to a single issued item); label flips to 'Deseleziona' and re-tap clears to 0. exit-select removes checkboxes and returns to normal navigation — tapping an issued card navigates to /declaration/<id> as expected. Bottom bar: 'Stampa / Invia selezionate' (print-selected) reports aria-disabled=true, pointer-events:none, opacity:0.5 when 0 selected, and becomes enabled ≥1. Tapping it with 1 selected and again with 3 selected calls exportDeclarationsBatchPdf → on WEB it invokes Print.printAsync which was window.print-patched during the test; NO red-screen and NO JS error is produced (app stays on Archivio, batch bar still visible). Regression on pdf.ts refactor: opened /declaration/<issued_id> and tapped preview-declaration-button → iframe titled 'Anteprima dichiarazione' renders with 'Dichiarazione di conformità alle normative CE', 'Etichetta' block, 'Codice lavoro' key, and both table.teeth grids present. preview-prescription-button renders iframe 'Anteprima prescrizione' with 'Prescrizione Odontoiatrica' + 'Lavorazioni ed elementi dentali richiesti' + Codice lavoro — still works after the extraction of declarationStyles()/declarationSheetHtml(). Cedolino columns: seeded one invoice via /api/invoices with 2 lines carrying patient_name + codice_lavoro, opened its detail and tapped preview-cedolino-button → the lines table <th> order is EXACTLY ['Paziente','Codice','Tipo di lavorazione','Elem.','Prezzo','Importo'] and both rows render Livesu Anna/0003/2026/Protesi Provvisoria — Provvisorio and Rossi Mario/0001/2026/Corona in Zirconia. Fattura (preview-invoice-button) still uses the classic 4-column header ['Descrizione','Q.tà','Prezzo unit.','Importo'] — unchanged. Only console noise seen are two RN-Web style-prop deprecations (shadow* / props.pointerEvents) — informational, not errors. Test invoice cleaned up (DELETE 200).
critical_code_review_comments: archive.tsx toast overlay (Toast is position:absolute top:insets.top+sm zIndex:9999) covers the header 'Tutte'/'Annulla' buttons; if a user taps DRAFT and immediately taps 'Tutte' within ~3s the second tap is absorbed by the toast. Not a bug in the requested behavior but a minor UX pitfall — consider setting pointerEvents:'box-none' on the Toast container so it doesn't intercept clicks that fall outside the toast pill.

archive.tsx printSelected (line 167) casts items via 'as unknown as DeclarationData[]'. That's OK because /declarations returns full docs, but it silently accepts drift if the list endpoint is ever trimmed. Consider a lightweight runtime check or fetching the full doc per id, at least in dev.

pdf.ts exportDeclarationsBatchPdf on native uses Print.printToFileAsync with width:595/height:842 for a single-page PDF; multi-sheet batches rely on the '.page-break' CSS to force page breaks. Behavior verified on WEB (uses Print.printAsync with the composed HTML). Native path unverified in this run — should be validated in an Expo Go / native build.

billing/[id].tsx preview-cedolino-button uses buildCedolinoHtml which now emits 6 columns; existing invoices whose lines predate patient_name/codice_lavoro fields render '—' in those columns (graceful). Fine as-is.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (16/16 checks: login, enter-select, draft-info-toast, issued-toggle, select-all issued-only, deseleziona, filter respected on Emesse/Bozze/search, print-selected disabled@0/enabled@≥1, batch print no crash for 1 and 3 items, exit-select, navigate to detail, preview-declaration-button, preview-prescription-button, cedolino 6-column headers with correct order, fattura headers unchanged)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 test invoice (FT-2026-0001) with 2 lines carrying patient_name+codice_lavoro to verify Cedolino columns. Deleted at end of run (DELETE /api/invoices/<id> → 200). No declarations were created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: tecnico@lab.it / password123. Archivio multi-select testIDs — enter-select (visible when NOT in select mode), select-all (visible when in select mode, label 'Tutte' or 'Deseleziona'), exit-select ('Annulla'), select-checkbox-<declId> on each card, print-selected in bottom bar (Stampa / Invia selezionate), filter-chip-{all|issued|draft}. On WEB, exportDeclarationsBatchPdf calls Print.printAsync which triggers window.print() — patch it in tests via `await page.evaluate("window.print = () => {}")` right after login and again after any full-page navigation, otherwise the browser print dialog can block subsequent clicks. Note that the app-wide Toast overlay (zIndex 9999) covers the header 'Tutte'/'Annulla' region for ~3s after each show() — use page.evaluate(el.click) or wait ~3.2s before clicking select-all/exit-select immediately after triggering a toast. Cedolino test needs an invoice whose lines have patient_name AND codice_lavoro set; the simplest path is POST /api/invoices with two manual lines (client_snapshot.name required) — no client_id/declaration_id needed. Cedolino header order is exactly: Paziente | Codice | Tipo di lavorazione | Elem. | Prezzo | Importo (pdf.ts cedolinoLinesHtml).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All requested behaviors verified.
